charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1101_0100:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] was walking
around town and called out to Saturn after
spotting him...
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_0200:
Hm. You’re [Name:PlayerNickname ],
right? Do you need something from me?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_0401_0400:
That’s some greeting. Does it appear that
way to you?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_0402_0600:
Hmph. Do you think I would tell you just
because you asked?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_0700: What I do is none of your business.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_0800:
As long as you stay out of my affairs, I
promise not to concern myself with yours.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_0900:
But on the off chance you do stand in my—
or Team Galactic’s—way, I will show no
mercy, even to a child.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_1000:
This Toxicroak is similar to me. She is
composed and fulfills her duties loyally.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_1100: If you treasure your Pokémon, leave us be.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_1200:
For my boss and Team Galactic, I’ll use any
means necessary. That is my duty.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_0401_1400: Oh? Are you insinuating I am wrong?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_0302_1500: Why not do things more freely?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_0402_1600:
Are you trying to say my organization
restricts me?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_1700:
I ascertain my own goals and take action
to achieve them. What about that shows a
lack of freedom?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_1900: It’s not that I follow my boss mindlessly.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2000:
It is true that Team Galactic aims to realize
our boss’s ideals.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1101_2100:
You probably believe I’m being used for that
purpose.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2200:
Although it may be someone else’s ideals, I
see value in them. That is enough reason to
devote my loyalty to the cause!
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2300:
I will work toward achieving my goals,
even if you think them evil.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2400: If freedom is your creed, loyalty is mine!
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2500:
Hmph. Are you incapable of understanding?
Well, I never sought your understanding
in the first place.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2700:
You say you stand for freedom and justice.
But can you claim them proudly as your
own thoughts and ideals?
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2800: Try asking yourself that, in your heart.
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_2900:
And if you say you will still stand in my
way, knowing my thoughts...
charaepi_ch0227_00_saturn/2301_1201_3000:
then come prepared to break the conviction
that Toxicroak and I hold!
